title: Payoneer — low-and-slow signals, sessions created vs verified
subtitle: Follow-up to DETCORE-4466. Source ARK_PROD.events.mini_events_log (session_setup + game_verify), exact counts.

signals.title: Resolution 1050x1000 spoofing kit (Firefox + Chrome variants)
signals.why: One anti-detect kit with a fixed 1050x1000 screen. The Firefox build trips g-dp-invalid-resolution (available resolution 2560x1392 > screen); the Chrome 151-156 build reports a consistent 1050x960 available resolution and does not. After the invalid-resolution flags went in on Oct 21 the Firefox line drops to ~0 while total volume reaches its high on Oct 26-27, i.e. the actor moved to the Chrome build. On Payoneer, 1050x1000 is 99-100% zh-CN + outlook/hotmail and never seen on Registration.

telltales.telltale_description: Device spoofing kit: fixed screen resolution 1050x1000 (not a real display). Same actor as payoneere3ef-h-dp-invalid-resolution-spoofing-browser-values but also covers the Chrome 151-156 build (available resolution 1050x960) that does not trip g-dp-invalid-resolution. On CLM since Sep 14: ~2.3k sessions / 45 days, 93% verified; zh-CN, CN mobile ISPs, outlook/hotmail, rotating WebGL renderers. Moved from Firefox to Chrome after Oct 21; peak 136/day on Oct 27.
telltales.external_description: Device spoofing: non-standard fixed screen resolution (1050x1000) reused across sessions with rotating device values. Low-and-slow on Payoneer CLM since Sep 14, ~93% verified, mostly outlook/hotmail from CN.

signals.title: Resolution 830x800 with no taskbar, Windows, hotmail (residential proxies) — tightened
signals.why: Tightened definition: fp_resolution = fp_available_resolution = 830x800 on Windows. A real Windows screen always loses height to the taskbar, so available = screen means injected values. The tightened rule keeps 100% of the 6,607 sessions (no 830x800 session on Payoneer had a different available resolution), so the chart is unchanged and nothing is lost. In the last 3 days 830x800 appeared on exactly one key across all of Arkose - Payoneer Login (159 sessions). vs normal Payoneer Windows traffic: 95% hotmail (baseline 5%), 48% 'en-EN' locale (0%), 3.9 sessions / 2.1 IPs per fingerprint (1.1 / 1.1), 16-core NVIDIA profile on a netbook-sized screen. CO/KR/JP/BR IPs with matching timezones but English-only browsers. Quiet on CLM since Oct 23, active on Login.

telltales.telltale_description: Device spoofing / residential-proxy actor: Windows reporting screen = available resolution = 830x800 (no taskbar - impossible on real Windows; resolution seen on no other Arkose key). 95% hotmail, fake 'en-EN' locale or 'en,en-US,en' language list, CO/KR/JP/BR residential IPs with matched timezones. ~6.6k sessions / 45 days on CLM + Login, 98-99% verified, rarely challenged; 66 init_fingerprints over ~1.5k IPs on Login. Moved CLM -> Login around Oct 19-23.
telltales.external_description: Device spoofing: screen and available resolution both a non-standard 830x800 on Windows (no taskbar), reused across many residential IPs. Low-and-slow on Payoneer CLM and Login since Sep 13, ~98% verified, mostly hotmail.

signals.title: Tencent Cloud + outlook 4-letters-4-digits handles
signals.why: Hosting-provider IPs (Tencent Cloud Beijing), zh-CN, Chrome 147/148, outlook handles matching ^[a-z]{4}\d{4}@. Burst on CLM Oct 7-19 (peak 355/day) at 98% verified; the existing payoneer-email-pattern-4-lowercase-letters-4-digits-outlook flag carries no pressure. Still trickling on Login and Registration.

telltales.telltale_description: Scripted registrations from Tencent Cloud (hosting) IPs with outlook.com handles of 4 lowercase letters + 4 digits, zh-CN, Chrome 147/148. CLM burst Oct 7-19 (peak 355/day, ~2.1k sessions, 98% verified); ~1.3k on Login and a trickle on Registration since Oct 20. Narrows payoneer-email-pattern-4-lowercase-letters-4-digits-outlook to the hosting-IP core.
telltales.external_description: Automated pattern: hosting-provider IPs combined with templated outlook.com handles (4 letters + 4 digits). Seen on Payoneer CLM, Login and Registration since Oct 6, ~98% verified.

signals.title: US outlook, 3440x1440, Chrome 150 (new Oct 22)
signals.why: Started Oct 22 on CLM at ~150-220/day, 97% verified, never challenged; starting on Login (63 on Oct 27). Ultrawide resolution + one Chrome build + US + outlook across hundreds of IPs. validate_telltale flags a ground_truth_overlap with a Roblox US ground truth (different key), likely spurious - confirm with the tester before creating.

telltales.telltale_description: Watch: US outlook.com registrations on Chrome 150 / Windows with 3440x1440 resolution, few init_fingerprints across hundreds of IPs. New Oct 22 on CLM (~1.1k sessions, 97% verified, 0% challenged), starting on Login (63 on Oct 27). Monitor only until confirmed.
telltales.external_description: Suspicious device cluster: identical uncommon device profile (3440x1440, Chrome 150) reused across many US IPs with outlook.com emails. Payoneer CLM since Oct 22.

signals.title: CN hotmail, 1280x960, Chrome 109 (Oct 19-26)
